_comment: The frozen 18-name placement predicate registry (§3.3.2, D-014/D-105). This is the single source: packages/verify/src/predicates/index.mjs must export exactly these as PREDICATES, and packages/verify/schema/assertions.schema.json must enum exactly these predicate names. g-no-prose-assertions fails on any drift between the three, and on any contract row naming a predicate not here. Adding or removing a predicate is a decision, not an edit.

predicates.name: cellCount
predicates.returns: number of cells in the row

predicates.name: cellRow
predicates.returns: the row name the node is a cell of

predicates.name: cellPx
predicates.returns: declared px for a fixed cell

predicates.name: cellsEqual
predicates.returns: true when every cell has the same sizing and, for fixed, the same px

predicates.name: rowGroupSizes
predicates.returns: number[], one per row group of the container's direct children

predicates.name: rowGroupMembers
predicates.returns: name[] sharing the node's row group

predicates.name: count
predicates.returns: number of components of that type in the tree
